__comment: Grafana dashboard definition for the telematics platform. Provisioned automatically alongside datasource.yml. Panels: live risk score per driver (time series), risk category distribution (pie chart), harsh braking events over time (bar chart), top 5 riskiest drivers (table). All queries use Flux against the InfluxDB-Telematics datasource, bucket 'telematics', measurement 'driver_risk'.
title: Connected Vehicle Insurance Telematics - Driver Risk

targets.query:
from(bucket: "telematics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "driver_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "risk_score")
  |> group(columns: ["driver_id"])
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "driver_id"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: "telematics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "driver_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "risk_score")
  |> group(columns: ["risk_category"])
  |> count()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["risk_category", "_value"])
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({r with row: "count"}))
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["row"], columnKey: ["risk_category"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["row"])
  |> yield(name: "risk_category_counts")

from(bucket: "telematics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "driver_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "harsh_brake_count")
  |> group(columns: ["driver_id"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 5m, fn: sum, createEmpty: false, timeSrc: "_start")
  |> keep(columns: ["_time", "_value", "driver_id"])
  |> group()
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["driver_id"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])
  |> yield(name: "harsh_brakes_per_5m")

from(bucket: "telematics")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "driver_risk")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "risk_score")
  |> group(columns: ["driver_id"])
  |> mean()
  |> group()
  |> keep(columns: ["driver_id", "_value"])
  |> rename(columns: {_value: "avg_risk_score"})
  |> sort(columns: ["avg_risk_score"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 5)
  |> yield(name: "top5_riskiest_drivers")
